audit: CRITIC #6: Ruthless Accessibility & Legal Compliance Audit

issues: Dropdown menu lacks Escape key handler
Calendar date picker missing keyboard navigation
Form error messages not announced to screen readers

No contact information for Privacy Commissioner complaints

Interactive elements with minimal touch targets (<44x44px)

No automated accessibility testing in CI/CD pipeline
No accessibility statement or policy page

violations: PIPEDA not mentioned in privacy policy
